purpose: Existing-access source feasibility for the six already captured expired SPY contracts. No authenticated calls are authorized or executed by this design task.

scope.metadata_time_semantics: Retrospective contract record retrieved now; not a February 2024 metadata snapshot.

credential_handling: Reuse frontier.paper_broker._paper_credentials only after root execution approval. Never print, serialize, or mix credential values. No environment read in this design.

evidence.finding: Historical option data begins February 2024. OPRA is subscription-based; indicative quotes are modified derivatives, not actual OPRA quotes.
Documented quote endpoint is GET /v1beta1/options/quotes/latest with symbols and feed; no historical start/end selectors are documented.
Documented historical request classes cover bars and trades; quotes use OptionLatestQuoteRequest. No historical option quote request class found.
Chain returns latest quote/trade/Greeks. updated_since is a lower-bound freshness filter, not an as-of historical chain selector.

prohibited_substitutes: Latest quote for an expired contract labeled as February 2024 history
Current chain/snapshot plus updated_since treated as historical chain
Indicative feed or missing feed default labeled OPRA
Bars/trades used to manufacture bid/ask observations
historical_opra_quotes.next_gate: Identify a primary documented historical quote endpoint and its entitlement semantics, then separately declare and review exact timestamps/page caps. No authenticated endpoint guessing.

metadata_probe.stop_policy: Stop the remaining probe on first non-200 response, transport failure, malformed JSON, response-size cap, or schema failure. In particular preserve 401/403/429 and stop without retries, host/feed substitution, purchase or entitlement changes. Empty 200 data is recorded missing, not silently replaced; other predeclared strikes may still be queried.
metadata_probe.pagination_policy: Retain any returned page_token or next_page_token without following. If present, classify that strike as page-limited/incomplete; do not infer absent contracts do not exist.
metadata_probe.full_denominator: Retain all three request statuses and all six requested contract statuses, including unattempted after stop. Keep unexpected returned symbols/raw records but never substitute them for missing expected symbols.
response_retention: Exact URL/query, request/code/source identities, UTC send/receive clocks and HTTP status
Raw response bytes and SHA256, or explicitly labeled bounded prefix if truncated
Response Date/content-type/request-id/rate-limit headers only; never request authentication headers
Original payload keys, nulls, errors and pagination markers
Per-contract matched/missing/ambiguous/unexpected state and each qualified/unavailable field
field_checks: Exact symbol/root/underlying/expiry/type/strike identity against the fixed six symbols; Decimal strike comparison
Retain size and all deliverables/cash/currency/asset identifiers with original values; no assumed multiplier or deliverable
Record actual status/tradable as retrieval-time values only
Keep open_interest_date and close_price_date separate from retrieval time and desired February window
Duplicate or conflicting records remain ambiguous; missing deliverables do not establish standard deliverables
metadata_probe.qualification: A successful response can establish retrospective metadata access and provider-reported contract terms only. It does not qualify historical OPRA quotes, historical chain completeness or executable options accounting.

reuse_plan.basis: Adapt the existing single-request probe locally; do not call its unchanged main because its endpoint is hard-locked to bars and would collide with retained attempt files.
reuse: Existing _paper_credentials resolver, raw SHA preservation, UTC timestamps, httpx streamed GET with redirects disabled, historical_lab._save
minimal_changes: Separate new output directory and immutable reviewed definition/code identity
Exact three metadata URL/query allowlist with one retained status per request and six-contract denominator
Enforce fixed streaming byte prefix cap and per-call deadline without silently treating truncation as success
Contract-specific response inspection instead of bar_counts; no SDK normalization that could drop deliverables
reuse_plan.prior_to_any_execution: Root reviews and freezes the request plus adapted wrapper. Offline mocked checks must cover exact scope, empty/missing/duplicate records, pagination, 401/403/429 global stop, truncation and no retained-attempt overwrite.

unknowns: Whether existing paper credentials can retrieve these inactive 2024 contracts
Whether the provider retains exact historical deliverable terms or only a current archived contract record
Historical first listing/de-listing dates and as-of chain membership
Actual OPRA historical quote endpoint and entitlement
Quote timestamp precision, conditions, sizes, crossed/locked/zero markets and observation gaps
Executable bid/ask fills, assignment/exercise cashflows and historical transaction tariffs

documentation.finding: Historical option data begins February 2024. OPRA is subscription-based; indicative quotes are modified derivatives, not actual OPRA quotes.
Documented quote endpoint is GET /v1beta1/options/quotes/latest with symbols and feed; no historical start/end selectors are documented.
Documented historical request classes cover bars and trades; quotes use OptionLatestQuoteRequest. No historical option quote request class found.
Chain returns latest quote/trade/Greeks. updated_since is a lower-bound freshness filter, not an as-of historical chain selector.
Paper GET list supports inactive status, underlying/root, exact expiration and strike bounds, show_deliverables, pagination and limit. No historical as-of parameter documented.
Paper GET by symbol or ID is documented, but the list endpoint documents show_deliverables and can request both call/put at an exact strike.
Contract model documents identity, expiry, type/style, strike, size, and separately dated open interest/close price. Size is not silently assumed to be 100.
